episodes.synopsis: The end of high school is near for a group of students but their yearning for reconnection might change the course of their lives.
episodes.title: On your marks!

episodes.synopsis: Haruto works up the courage to ask out Morikawa but does his confession go as well as he had envisioned it?
episodes.title: Question

episodes.synopsis: The group reconnects after their trip to the aquarium but things take an unexpected turn when Ena takes an interest in Eita.
episodes.title: Andante

episodes.synopsis: Emotions run high as Haruto feels emboldened enough to finally confess his feelings, but will his words be able to reach the one he cares about?
episodes.title: Full swing

episodes.synopsis: Things change between Haruto and Hazuki, and both of them try to deal with it in their own way. Mio, on the other hand, is trying to come to terms with her feelings.
episodes.title: Rolling Stones

episodes.synopsis: Tension is on the rise, as Haruto seeks guidance from Eita, on how to respond to Hazuki's message.
episodes.title: Restart

episodes.synopsis: Mio remembers Eita's kindness in middle school and starts to question her relationship with him. What will happen as Ena begins to spend more time with Eita?
episodes.title: Snow day

episodes.synopsis: Ena finally decides to ask Eita on a date despite Mio's objection. Everything seems to be going well until Mio bumps into them.
episodes.title: High Dynamic Range

episodes.synopsis: Mio finally chooses to confront her demons. In the meantime, Eita is working through his own dilemma with Ena.
episodes.title: Answer

episodes.synopsis: Eita seems to be coming to terms with his feelings. In the meantime, Mio is starting to learn what is truly important to her.
episodes.title: Childhood's end

episodes.synopsis: As entrance exams rear their head, Eita can't help but remember Mio's expression when she noticed his phone. What will happen as their paths start to diverge?
episodes.title: Roundabout

episodes.synopsis: Eita fails his entrance exam. He receives a text from Mio telling him she passed the test for her first choice. It's graduation and everyone says their good-byes. Eita tells Komiya that he was happy when she confessed to him but still, he can't go out with her because there is someone else he likes. After he left, she is seen crying in the club room. Eita runs into Mio at Joei; he confesses to liking her and she reciprocates.
episodes.title: Get set, go!
